correctness.rationale: The signed 2-block decomposition P,Q is exact by the binary join rule; the closed prefix maxima p,q,U,V and earliest positions u,v follow by induction. All length-2^k windows straddle at most two dyadic blocks. Bounding both block-order types by A_k,B_k and establishing the strict gap A_k<H_k is valid for k>=2. Exact sign tables at odd block indices 1,3,5,11 give the earliest eligible pair; u,v give the earliest offset. The formulas are proved for every k>=2; an exact-integer checker independently matches complete scanned windows for k=2,...,16. Finite checks are supporting, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The sharp first-observation horizon is a natural exact pattern-retrieval/Abelian-factor statistic. Prior work determines which Parikh vectors are possible, whereas the new theorem quantifies the earliest prefix in which each extreme can be seen, with four different exact parity-split laws and a large positive/negative asymmetry. The result covers infinitely many lengths, has an independent structural block-pair mechanism, and does not rest on an arbitrary single finite computation.
